description:
Please note that this solicitation is not ready to be issued as of this date. The Embassy of the United States in Seoul, Korea requires monthly maintenance service for water purifiers at the U.S. Embassy in Seoul.

The Government plans to issue solicitation in April 2026. The solicitation will be posted on https://www.sam.gov and the Embassy website. No paper copies will be made available. Please see the RFQ for the actual response date and for specific quotation requirements.
